app.name: LazyTO
app.coder: Kegstand (LazyTO); Slippi Nintendont by FIX94, crediar, Fizzi, meta, Nicolet, nikki
app.long_description: LazyTO: Slippi Nintendont with the tournament kiosk. Boots Melee into a start.gg set list, scores games automatically and reports them through the venue relay. Needs sd:/lazyto_kiosk.bin and sd:/lazyto_station.txt. Built on Slippi Nintendont (https://github.com/project-slippi/Nintendont).
